title: Maya asks for TV on a school night
blurb: 21:15 on a Tuesday. The decider understands 'turn on the TV'; the policy knows who asked and checks with a parent first.

steps.text: Tuesday, 21:15, a school night. Maya is supposed to be in bed.
The decider understood the request, but the policy knows who asked: a child, after 20:00, on a school night. It asks a parent's phone instead of acting.
Alex said yes from the bedroom, so the TV came on. A 'No' would have left it off.
Permissions live in plain code, where they can be read and audited.
